reason: My Instagram page makes me pay a deposit and wait, so a first order with nothing up front, cash on delivery, is a risk I can take. I would try one small order of kids' clothes from a screenshot and compare the total with what my page charges.
objection: 21,000 IQD in fees on one kilo feels heavy for cheap kids' things, and I am used to my page. If the total comes out more than my page, I go back to them.
would_change_my_mind: If my first order comes out more expensive than my usual page, or it arrives late, I will not order again.
